title: Prime Medicine
summary: US biotech commercialising prime editing for genetic disease.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Prime Medicine develops therapies based on prime editing, a CRISPR-derived method that can rewrite DNA without double-strand breaks. Its pipeline targets liver, blood and eye diseases, with partnerships supporting delivery and manufacturing. The technology is early and capital-intensive.

Technology Exposure

  • Prime editing therapies
  • Delivery technology
  • Partnership-funded programmes

What To Watch

  • First clinical data
  • Delivery and specificity
  • Funding

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
